text:
nightly-ci-bot: Alert — nightly-perf job breached threshold. small-batch p95 for model redwood/r1-large (seq=512) increased 210ms -> 256ms (+22%). Build: ci/infra@abc123. Artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/nightlies/2645016789
alex: saw the alert, grabbing a bisect now. pinging @tim for deeper profiling.
maya: requeued the job in debug mode (tag: debug/2645016789) for faster artifacts, link: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/2645016789-debug
tim: on it — pulling perf artifacts and flamegraphs. maya, can you re-run with KV tracing? `--trace-kv=1` please.
sam: quick check — did we ship any infra/kernel or scheduler tweaks yesterday? I remember a small affinity/scheduler PR.
jen: infra merged deploy/infra#452 (affinity/scheduler tweak) yesterday morning. it touched batch scheduler heuristics but was labelled low-risk.
alex: let's collect traces before rolling back. tim, try a local perf record: `perf record -F 99 -g -- ./bin/bench_small_batch --model r1-large --seq 512` and upload flamegraph.
tim: uploaded flamegraph: https://perf.redwood/internal/fg/2645016789.svg
maya: tail from runner logs around the spike:
```
[2026-03-17T03:11:58Z] kvcache miss spike: 1200 -> 3100 ops/s
[2026-03-17T03:12:05Z] scheduler queue depth +3
[2026-03-17T03:12:07Z] p95 increased from 210ms to 256ms
```
sam: KV miss spike + scheduler bump — could be eviction policy or LRU window regression. PR 1783 modified LRU window math last week.
jen: can we bisect to PR 1783? that seems likely.
alex: starting git bisect locally against nightly artifacts. if you can reproduce locally try env `RW_KV_LRU_WINDOW=0.5` to force previous behavior.
tim: local repro confirmed — p95 regresses ~20% with the new LRU behaviour.
maya: created a hotfix branch reverting the LRU tweak: `git checkout -b hotfix/revert-lru-1783 && git revert abc1234` and pushed.
alex: please run the nightly bench against that hotfix branch.
maya: kicked off hotfix run: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/hotfix/repro/2645016789 — ETA ~12m.
nightly-ci-bot: Job update — hotfix run completed: small-batch p95 212ms (back to baseline).
sam: good signal. recommend cherry-pick to canary and redeploy to a small percentage.
jen: I'll own the canary deploy (ETA ~30m). tagging release rc/2645016789 and scheduling rollout to 5% capacity.
alex: great. can someone add a short PR note referencing this thread and add a regression test to nightlies to catch the LRU edge case?
tim: will add a unit/regression test for the LRU boundary and a stress checker in the bench harness.
maya: monitoring scheduled for next 3 nightlies, will update if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
alex: thanks team — excellent triage. closing the immediate alert but leaving follow-ups for test + canary verification.
